judgments.value_text: Rova-T represented a multi-billion-dollar peak revenue opportunity.
judgments.summary: At the 2016 Stemcentrx acquisition, AbbVie publicly attached a multi-billion-dollar peak-revenue expectation to Rova-T before the later randomized failures were knowable.
